historical_target_distribution.interpretation: Raw targets retained. Position distribution is a possible mechanism to investigate, not a causal conclusion about order sensitivity.

cost.boundary: Historical per-item timings are provenance only, not newly incurred cost; E7 actual tokens/stop/per-item GPU unknown. Smoke counted once through cache. Installation/download/load excluded.

semantic_review: AI-assisted blinded illustrative review: two development questions, eight cases, sixteen opinions; locked before model-map joining. Not independent human truth or population evidence. See ai_assisted/AI_REVIEW.md.

limits: AI simulation, not real biomedical experts or independent human review
No prevalence or model superiority inference
Stylish outputs and question repetition limit blinding
Outputs are reasons, not internal reasoning evidence
Human references/gold were hidden and not rewritten
Fixed final three epochs, no dev checkpoint selection
Same582 historical targets; proxy limitations preserved
Starting-model training histories differ, not pure scale effect
E7 historical direct-HF backend; migration verified on10, not604 regenerated
Question gold direction may penalize appropriate maybe/no-answer under insufficient retrieved evidence; sufficiency assessed separately
McNemar exploratory correct/incorrect only, no macro-F1 significance or multiplicity adjustment
